name: MQCyberSec
candidate_notes: Academic CTF team / university club at Macquarie University; link found by the CTFtime link hunt. Primary club Discord (~1,233 members) listed on MQCyberSec's official Linktree, page notes 'uni wifi blocks' it. name: FAUST CTF 2026
candidate_notes: Academic CTF team / university club at Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU); link found by the CTFtime link hunt. Discord invite is on the FAUST CTF 2023 competition site's contact page ('Come join us on Discord!'), run by FAUST, FAU's CTF team. It is the event Discord rather than a confirmed standing team community server, but is the only public chat link found.
